import pygame

from scene import Circle, Drawing, Ellipse, Ground, Line, Scene, Sky

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
START_POSITION = (80, 210)
BACKGROUND = (8, 124, 168)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (244, 164, 55)
FISH_FIN_COLOUR = (255, 205, 80)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(*START_POSITION, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
ocean = scene.add("ocean", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
seabed = scene.add("seabed", Ground("#d6b15e"),
                   size=(640, 90), at=(0, 390), layer="scenery")
seaweed = scene.add("seaweed", Drawing((50, 65), [
    Line((10, 60), (5, 10), "white", width=6),
    Line((20, 60), (24, 0), "white", width=6),
    Line((30, 60), (40, 14), "white", width=6),
]), size=(50, 65), at=(45, 325), count=5, layer="scenery")
coral = scene.add("coral", Drawing((55, 70), [
    Line((25, 65), (25, 20), "white", width=8),
    Line((25, 38), (8, 22), "white", width=7),
    Line((25, 45), (43, 12), "white", width=7),
    Circle(25, 15, 7, "white"),
    Circle(8, 18, 6, "white"),
    Circle(43, 9, 6, "white"),
]), size=(55, 70), at=(270, 320), count=3, layer="scenery")
rocks = scene.add("rocks", Ground("#526b73"), size=(640, 35), at=(0, 360), layer="scenery")
jellyfish = scene.add("jellyfish", Drawing((60, 58), [
    Ellipse(8, 5, 44, 30, "white"),
    Line((14, 32), (10, 52), "white", width=4),
    Line((25, 32), (25, 50), "white", width=4),
    Line((36, 32), (42, 52), "white", width=4),
]), size=(60, 58), at=(450, 160), count=3, moves=(-2, 0), layer="things")
bubbles = scene.add("bubbles", Drawing((48, 40), [
    Circle(8, 8, 6, "white"),
    Circle(22, 28, 4, "white"),
    Circle(38, 15, 3, "white"),
]), size=(48, 40), at=(150, 90), count=5, moves=(0, -1), layer="effects")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching jellyfish sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touching(player, "jellyfish"):
        player.topleft = START_POSITION

    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    # Draw the fish over the scene: body, tail, fin, and eye.
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.draw.polygon(screen, FISH_FIN_COLOUR, [
        (player.left + 8, player.centery),
        (player.left - 8, player.top + 8),
        (player.left - 8, player.bottom - 8),
    ])
    pygame.draw.polygon(screen, FISH_FIN_COLOUR, [
        (player.centerx, player.top + 7),
        (player.centerx + 12, player.top - 5),
        (player.centerx + 18, player.top + 10),
    ])
    pygame.draw.circle(screen, (20, 35, 45), (player.right - 10, player.top + 11), 3)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

import pygame

CAR_HEIGHT = 32

ROAD_TOP = 345
ROAD_BOTTOM = 448

pygame.display.set_caption("Snowy Night")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

                                size=(18, 24), at=(75, 220), count=10, layer="effects")

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:

    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:

    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
